current_code_behavior: Sorts by PAXDAYM/PAXSSNMP, then uses per-day cumcount as minute index; no source timestamp reconstruction.
historical_claim_or_label: P01_10m is treated as a temporal transition probability.
correction_required: Use source-clock time and the 80-Hz sample coordinate; do not derive minute time from row ordinal.

current_code_behavior: PAXSSNMP is used only as a sort key; no sample-number difference is tested.
historical_claim_or_label: PAXSSNMP can establish exact sample time/continuity.
correction_required: Convert sample number to elapsed time using 80 Hz and anchor it to PAXFTIME.

current_code_behavior: Every consecutive element of the flattened nocturnal block array is treated as adjacent.
historical_claim_or_label: A transition requires adjacent epochs of fixed width.
correction_required: Require next_timestamp-current_timestamp == epoch_width within the same night segment.

current_code_behavior: Only PAXQFM 1 and 2 are rejected; official rule is every value >0 invalid.
historical_claim_or_label: All QC-invalid minutes are removed.
correction_required: Require PAXQFM == 0 and exclude all positive QC flags.

current_code_behavior: Available minute MIMS values are summed without requiring a complete 5/10/30/60-minute block.
historical_claim_or_label: Each P01 state represents a complete fixed-width block.
correction_required: Require full valid contiguous minute coverage for every block; exclude incomplete blocks.

current_code_behavior: Median is participant-wide across all nonempty blocks and all recorded day-times; partial blocks can contribute.
historical_claim_or_label: Threshold is a participant median over full-day blocks.
correction_required: Prespecify eligible complete blocks and participant threshold scope; record it in output metadata.

current_code_behavior: Selects blocks overlapping 00:00-06:00 and 22:00-24:00 within each PAXDAYM.
historical_claim_or_label: Nocturnal activity represents one coherent overnight interval.
correction_required: Assign 22:00 day d and 00:00-06:00 day d+1 to a single night_id.

current_code_behavior: Sorted sequence places early-morning blocks before late-evening blocks on the same wear-day.
historical_claim_or_label: No artificial temporal transitions are included.
correction_required: Keep the two clock segments separate across daytime; connect only real consecutive epochs.

current_code_behavior: 23:50 day d and 00:00 day d+1 may be neighboring array entries, but elapsed-time continuity is not checked.
historical_claim_or_label: Midnight transitions are evaluated only when truly contiguous.
correction_required: Retain a midnight transition only when source timestamps prove exact adjacency and both blocks are complete.

current_code_behavior: Absent blocks disappear from the flattened sequence; missing source rows are not reconstructed from sample-number gaps.
historical_claim_or_label: Missing or invalid gaps break the transition sequence.
correction_required: Break sequences at missing, invalid, nonconsecutive, or incomplete epochs; never bridge gaps.

current_code_behavior: PAXTSM is available in source metadata but not loaded or used to require a full minute.
historical_claim_or_label: Minute epochs are complete.
correction_required: Use duration metadata as part of the complete-minute predicate.

current_code_behavior: Cohort uses PAXDAYD 1-7; official wear protocol has partial first/last days and seven full days between.
historical_claim_or_label: The gate represents seven full protocol days.
correction_required: Choose and document the intended day window; use days 2-8 if the target is seven full days.

current_code_behavior: A day is adequate only when PAXQFD <0.5 and PAXVMD >=600.
historical_claim_or_label: Any positive daily QC flag invalidates the entire day.
correction_required: Prespecify whether a single flagged minute invalidates a day or whether valid-minute count governs.

current_code_behavior: Builder sums only DPQ010-DPQ090, maps 7/9 to missing, requires all nine, clips 0-27, and flags score >=10.
historical_claim_or_label: PHQ-9 is the nine symptom-item sum; DPQ100 is not an item.
correction_required: No change required to the primary cohort definition.

current_code_behavior: Generic DPQ discovery includes DPQ100 and sum skips missing items without min_count=9.
historical_claim_or_label: Resolution regressions use PHQ9_Score.
correction_required: Use explicit DPQ010-DPQ090 and require all nine answers.

current_code_behavior: WASO groups same-day 00:00-06:00 with 22:00-24:00 and counts algorithm-predicted wake between first/last predicted sleep.
historical_claim_or_label: WASO_proxy_min is proxy-only, not PSG WASO.
correction_required: Build coherent overnight night_id, handle nonwear/unknown gaps, and retain proxy-only label.

current_code_behavior: Night_Wake_Min/Night_Sleep_Min sum same-day hour indices 00-05 and 22-23 across days; row order is used, missing values become zero.
historical_claim_or_label: Nightly wake/sleep minutes summarize overnight hours.
correction_required: Reconstruct hour timestamps, form overnight IDs, preserve missingness, and define per-night aggregation.

current_code_behavior: SLD010H is assigned to TST; official item asks self-reported usual weekday/workday sleep hours.
historical_claim_or_label: TST is an objective or actigraphy-derived sleep duration.
correction_required: Rename/document as self-reported usual weekday sleep duration.

current_code_behavior: SLQ060 doctor-told sleep-disorder history is encoded as Sleep_Medication.
historical_claim_or_label: Model adjusts for sleep medication.
correction_required: Rename as physician-reported sleep-disorder history; do not imply medication use.

current_code_behavior: Continuous PHQ9_Score; M1 P01+Age+Sex+BMI; M2 adds PIR+TST+WASO; each model has separate complete cases.
historical_claim_or_label: OLS coefficient is an adjusted change in PHQ-9 score.
correction_required: Interpret against model-specific sample and correctly named sleep constructs.

current_code_behavior: P01 is raw and unstandardized; coefficient scale is continuous PHQ-9 points per +1.00 probability unit.
historical_claim_or_label: Active model reports raw P01 coefficient.
correction_required: For a +0.01 P01 difference, state 0.01*beta_P01 PHQ-9 points; this is a unit conversion, not a model estimate.

current_code_behavior: Age/BMI are z-scored in M1; Age/BMI/PIR/TST/WASO in M2 using each model sample and ddof=0; Sex and P01 remain raw.
historical_claim_or_label: All predictors are standardized.
correction_required: Document predictor scale exactly; do not describe all predictors as standardized.

current_code_behavior: statsmodels OLS fit uses default ordinary nonrobust covariance; no cov_type or survey design.
historical_claim_or_label: SE/p-values are robust or survey-adjusted.
correction_required: Prespecify suitable covariance/design inference and label current output nonrobust.

current_code_behavior: No active fitted model passes WTMEC2YR, SDMVSTRA, or SDMVPSU.
historical_claim_or_label: NHANES population inference accounts for complex sample design.
correction_required: Use examined-sample candidate weight WTMEC2YR and design variables; resolve PAX nonresponse/valid-wear adjustment.

current_code_behavior: DEMO schema contains WTMEC2YR/SDMVSTRA/SDMVPSU; PAXMIN analytic note says examined weights should always be used.
historical_claim_or_label: A separate PAM weight is required or WTMEC2YR alone is always sufficient.
correction_required: Ask KAN-173 whether PAX available-data/valid-wear selection needs additional nonresponse adjustment; no separate PAX weight was named in retrieved codebook.

current_code_behavior: Paper script reports/plots in-sample AUC and also runs stratified 5-fold CV with fold-specific fits; no CI or AUC-difference test.
historical_claim_or_label: The plotted ROC is cross-validated and AUC gain is inferential.
correction_required: Label in-sample curves or plot held-out predictions; report uncertainty and prespecified comparison.

current_code_behavior: All three Logit models are fit and predicted on the same complete-case rows; no CV/CI/test.
historical_claim_or_label: Three-model AUCs estimate held-out performance.
correction_required: Use held-out/cross-validated predictions and uncertainty, or label apparent in-sample AUC.

current_code_behavior: Fixed text asserts every adjusted coefficient is significant and P01 direction is positive without checking fitted p-values/sign.
historical_claim_or_label: Generated interpretation reflects fitted coefficient results.
correction_required: Generate significance/direction statements only from the fitted coefficients and prespecified inference.

current_code_behavior: All five scripts default away from canonical data/raw; legacy raw dir and root-level source fallbacks are used.
historical_claim_or_label: Repository defaults reproduce from data/raw.
correction_required: Migrate active source loaders to data/raw and remove obsolete fallbacks.

current_code_behavior: Resolution script defaults to historical processed_data_physics_ultimate.csv; if absent, first-chunk discovery caps default target at 200 SEQNs.
historical_claim_or_label: Resolution sensitivity runs on the final cohort.
correction_required: Use canonical final cohort and make any sample cap explicit.

current_code_behavior: A cache covering all SEQNs is accepted without source hash or algorithm version; cache absent at audit time.
historical_claim_or_label: Corrected P01 code always recomputes current metrics.
correction_required: Invalidate old cache or key it to data checksum and algorithm version.
